full_details: At breakfast the almanac had the moon new. The loaf was a penny and short by a finger. You paid threepence. The stool stood level. The Sunday letter was gone with Hobbins, and your father's cough was already known to be gone. You did not pay Edith, and you did not pay the mercer. At two you opened The Comedy of Errors a third time. At the reckoning Heminges would not name a figure for the week. Last Saturday was thirty shillings, the best since Christmas, and he left it as last Saturday. Garnish read twenty-four lines, Monday's tally, with nothing added and no song. Edith's eight shillings stayed unpaid. The watchet stayed at fifty shillings unpaid. The Queen's twenty pounds was not had. Monday's bill is The Two Gentlemen of Verona at two of the clock. At home you did not open the coffer to write a sum.
one_sentence: The moon was new, you played Egeon again, and last Saturday's thirty shillings stayed the last share.
title: Played Egeon and sat the week's reckoning
